Is Thrive Agency a real estate-specific platform?
No. Thrive Agency is a general-purpose digital marketing agency based in Arlington, Texas. They serve dozens of industries including e-commerce, healthcare, legal, and real estate.
Does Thrive Agency have a client dashboard?
Yes. Thrive clients log in to Thrive Local, which has a dashboard, a visual calendar, approval workflows and Thrive Stats reporting.
Can I approve content before it goes live with Thrive Agency?
Yes. Thrive Local lets you approve or request changes to posts from your email or in a visual-calendar approval workflow.
Does Thrive Agency require long-term contracts?

Thrive says it does not require long-term contracts, but pricing is custom, so you only learn the cost after a consultation. VEXI has no contracts — cancel anytime, transparent pricing on the website, and a 15-day free trial so you can try before you commit.
